calls.statement:
WITH as_of AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key CROSS JOIN as_of
  WHERE f.sale_date > e - 364 AND f.sale_date <= e)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) nd
FROM active a CROSS JOIN as_of JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id=a.member_id AND e BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH w AS (SELECT DATE '2024-12-22' AS s, DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, m.member_id, s.store_id, p.category, f.channel_code, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key, w
  WHERE f.sale_date > s AND f.sale_date <= e)
SELECT 'all' k, count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl 999/ZZ', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'only 999/ZZ lines members', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l WHERE (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL SELECT 'nonpositive', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'web cancelled', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM l JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE o.status='cancelled'

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) multi_at_asof,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) valid_at_asof,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date <= DATE '2025-12-21') joined_by_asof,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) badtier
FROM dim_member
